# SwishAI

> Upload a basketball video and SwishAI counts shots, baskets and accuracy for you. Runs entirely in your browser — the video never leaves your device.

The video is decoded, analysed and annotated by the browser itself. Nothing but the
counts ever reaches a server, and only for people who choose to keep a history.

## Pages

- [Count basketball shots from your video](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/process-video/): Upload a basketball video and SwishAI counts shots, baskets and accuracy for you, entirely in your browser — the video never leaves your device.
- [Plans and pricing](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/subscription/): Compare the free plan with Pro: how long a video can be, how many sessions stay visible, and what your shooting history keeps.
- [Terms of service](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/terms/): The terms you accept when you use SwishAI: what the app does, what the counts are worth, and what is expected of your account.
- [Privacy notice](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/privacy/): What SwishAI stores and what it never sees. Your video is processed in your browser and is never uploaded anywhere.
- [Refunds and withdrawal](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/refunds/): How to cancel a SwishAI subscription, when you get your money back, and how the EU right of withdrawal applies.
- [Company information](https://swish-ai-startup.github.io/SwishAI-web/imprint/): Who runs SwishAI: company details, registered address and how to get in touch.
